title: lycopodium × issleri
intro: Lycopodium × issleri, commonly known as spiny club moss, is a rare and hybrid species of the Lycopodiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium × issleri include stimulating digestion, relieving respiratory issues, and treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
